display_name: Weather Profiles v1 (named atmospheric and oceanic regimes)
purpose: Named atmospheric / oceanic regime cards covering cloud cover (ITU-R P.840-8), rain (ITU-R P.838-3), refractivity / ducting (ITU-R P.453-14), sea state (Pierson-Moskowitz 1964, WMO Beaufort), and MODTRAN-style EO/IR band transmission. Cards drive the radar propagation chain, EO/IR sensor archetypes, and clutter-Doppler models. Strict-open posture: every parameter cites ITU-R, WMO, Pierson-Moskowitz, or published climate atlases; no measured-truth claim.

license.notice: Pack content derived from public ITU-R recommendations, WMO standards, Pierson-Moskowitz 1964, MODTRAN technical documentation, and public climate atlases. No measured-truth or site-specific operational claim.

source_refs: Public climate atlases (Persian Gulf, Black Sea, Ukraine, Eastern Mediterranean, Arabian Sea monsoon)

notes: Five-card seed: UAE Coastal Summer, Ukraine Winter, Black Sea Autumn Moderate Duct, Gulf Monsoon Heavy Rain, Mediterranean Clear Air. Each card populates all required weather_profile.schema.json fields and at least one optional sub-block (cloud_cover, rain, fog, sea_state, refractivity_profile, eo_ir_transmission_bands).

Each card is consumed by the radar propagation chain (crates/echoforge-radar/src/propagation.rs + crates/echoforge-radar/src/weather/) and downstream EO/IR sensor archetypes. EO/IR transmission entries are computed via the MODTRAN-style band model in crates/echoforge-radar/src/weather/modtran_eo_ir.rs.

No card claims measured-truth fidelity; declared validation tier is 'basic' and fidelity_class is 'primitive_decomposed'. Cross-card numerical consistency between Pierson-Moskowitz H_s / ω_peak / Beaufort fields is enforced by tests/case_studies/ (lands in later wave).
